source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Magneto (Max Eisenhardt) (archived 29 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant, now confirmed Omega-level, with near-limitless command of magnetism.

abilities.name: Magnetism control
abilities.detail: Commands magnetism and metal on a vast scale: he has moved mountains, raised islands, changed the course of rivers and assembled complex machines in seconds.

abilities.name: Force fields
abilities.detail: Keeps near-constant magnetic shields that have held against Thor's hammer, Cyclops's optic blasts and nuclear detonations.

abilities.name: Flight and space travel
abilities.detail: Flies long distances on magnetic field lines, and crosses space inside a bubble of air held by his force field.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic spectrum
abilities.detail: Generates and redirects electricity, light and other electromagnetic energy, and can bend light around himself to turn invisible.

abilities.name: Organic iron control
abilities.detail: Moves the trace iron in living things, enough to tug at blood flow to the brain; he once pulled adamantium straight out of Wolverine.

abilities.name: Telepathic resistance
abilities.detail: Trained himself to resist telepaths even while unconscious, an edge his helmet strengthens further.

abilities.name: Scientific genius
abilities.detail: An expert geneticist and engineer who built magnetic spacecraft, space stations, robots and machines that cancel mutant powers.

abilities.name: Seasoned fighter
abilities.detail: Decades of combat; boosting his body with his powers, he can hold his own against Iron Man.

feats.text: Fought Thor by magnetically keeping him from his hammer long enough that the thunder god turned back into Donald Blake.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Journey Into Mystery Vol 1 109

feats.text: Ripped the adamantium out of Wolverine's skeleton with magnetism during the X-Men's raid on his orbital base, Avalon.
Dragged the giant bullet holding Kitty Pryde back from deep space to Earth; the strain left him in a coma.
feats.where: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 #521 to #522 (April to May 2010)

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 521
Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 522

feats.text: Atop the Statue of Liberty, he stopped Wolverine's claws in mid-strike to protect his mutation machine.
Pulled liquid iron out of a guard's blood, shaped it into metal balls and smashed his way out of his plastic prison.
Tore the Golden Gate Bridge loose and used it to link the mainland with Alcatraz Island.
